overview.text: Soil_1_32 is a hybrid nonribosomal peptide and azole-containing RiPP cluster identified by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO.
The locus spans 103 kb on contig_1 and contains 42 genes.

genes.text: antiSMASH marks 12 genes as biosynthetic, comprising 7 core and 5 additional genes, alongside 4 regulatory and 6 transport genes.
Six core NRPS genes are named by all three detection tools: CJLEIP_03619, CJLEIP_03620, CJLEIP_03621, CJLEIP_03622, CJLEIP_03623 and CJLEIP_03624.
CJLEIP_03619 carries three modules predicted to load leucine, phenylalanine and an unidentified residue, with two modules containing an epimerization domain.
CJLEIP_03620 is the largest with six modules predicted to load alanine twice, valine twice, leucine and isoleucine, and three modules bearing an epimerization domain.
CJLEIP_03621 contains four modules predicted to load threonine, valine, leucine and tryptophan, one of which has an epimerization domain.
CJLEIP_03622 holds two modules predicted to load lysine, one with an epimerization domain.
CJLEIP_03623 has a single module predicted to load isoleucine.
CJLEIP_03624 possesses two modules predicted to load alanine and isoleucine, one carrying an epimerization domain.

Together these six NRPS genes hold 18 modules in total, with substrates predicted for 16 modules including leucine for three, phenylalanine for one, alanine for three, valine for three, isoleucine for three, threonine for one, tryptophan for one and lysine for one, while one module lacks a substrate prediction and another lacks an adenylation or acyltransferase domain; eight modules carry an epimerization domain.

The additional biosynthetic genes include an MbtH family protein (CJLEIP_03631), a GTP cyclohydrolase I FolE (CJLEIP_03604), a serine hydrolase (CJLEIP_03625), an alpha/beta hydrolase (CJLEIP_03632) and an aldehyde dehydrogenase (CJLEIP_03633).

similar.text: The closest MIBiG entry is BGC0001792 from Streptomyces albidoflavus, which produces surugamide A and surugamide D.

This is a close match, with 23 locus genes having counterparts in the reference cluster at 98 to 100 percent identity and antiSMASH finding counterparts for 100 percent of the reference cluster's genes.
The six core NRPS genes match their counterparts XNR_3446 through XNR_3449 at 99 to 100 percent identity.

hypothesis.text: Given the close similarity to the surugamide cluster and the presence of multiple NRPS modules predicted to incorporate hydrophobic and aromatic amino acids, this cluster may produce a surugamide-like cyclic peptide with antifungal activity; the additional hydrolases and aldehyde dehydrogenase could further tailor the peptide backbone, while the GTP cyclohydrolase and MbtH protein suggest roles in cofactor supply and NRPS efficiency.

facts.sentence: Soil_1_32 is a nonribosomal peptide and azole-containing-RiPP cluster, found by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO (all three detection tools).
It spans 103 kb on contig_1 (4,060,268–4,163,383) and contains 42 genes.
antiSMASH marks 12 genes as biosynthetic (7 core and 5 additional), 4 as regulatory and 6 as transport.
6 core genes are named in the locus, each by at least one of the three detection tools, antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO.

CJLEIP_03619, annotated by Bakta as D-alanine--poly(phosphoribitol) ligase subunit DltA, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO; antiSMASH classes it as a core NRPS gene; antiSMASH finds 3 modules in it, and predicts leucine, phenylalanine and no substrate for its adenylation domains; 2 of its modules carry an epimerization domain.

CJLEIP_03620, annotated by Bakta as solanimycin non-ribosomal peptide synthetase SolG, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO; antiSMASH classes it as a core NRPS gene; antiSMASH finds 6 modules in it, and predicts alanine for 2, valine for 2, leucine for 1 and isoleucine for 1 for its adenylation domains; 3 of its modules carry an epimerization domain.

CJLEIP_03621, annotated by Bakta as D-alanine--poly(phosphoribitol) ligase subunit DltA, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO; antiSMASH classes it as a core NRPS gene; antiSMASH finds 4 modules in it, and predicts threonine, valine, leucine and tryptophan for its adenylation domains; 1 of its modules carries an epimerization domain.

CJLEIP_03622, annotated by Bakta as Amino acid adenylation domain-containing protein, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO; antiSMASH classes it as a core NRPS gene; antiSMASH finds 2 modules in it, and predicts lysine for its adenylation domain; 1 of its modules carries an epimerization domain.

CJLEIP_03623, annotated by Bakta as condensation domain-containing protein, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO; antiSMASH classes it as a core NRPS gene; antiSMASH finds 1 module in it, and predicts isoleucine for its adenylation domain.

CJLEIP_03624, annotated by Bakta as Amino acid adenylation domain-containing protein, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO; antiSMASH classes it as a core NRPS gene; antiSMASH finds 2 modules in it, and predicts alanine and isoleucine for its adenylation domains; 1 of its modules carries an epimerization domain.

Together these 6 NRPS and UNKNOWN genes with modules (CJLEIP_03619, CJLEIP_03620, CJLEIP_03621, CJLEIP_03622, CJLEIP_03623 and CJLEIP_03624) hold 18 modules in all; antiSMASH predicts a substrate for 16 modules (leucine for 3, phenylalanine for 1, alanine for 3, valine for 3, isoleucine for 3, threonine for 1, tryptophan for 1 and lysine for 1) and none for 1 module; 1 module has no adenylation or acyltransferase domain; 8 modules carry an epimerization domain.
CJLEIP_03631 encodes MbtH family protein and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.
CJLEIP_03604 encodes GTP cyclohydrolase I FolE and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.
CJLEIP_03625 encodes Serine hydrolase and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.
CJLEIP_03632 encodes Alpha/beta hydrolase and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.
CJLEIP_03633 encodes Aldehyde dehydrogenase domain-containing protein and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.

23 genes of the locus have a counterpart in BGC0001792, at 98–100 % identity; antiSMASH finds counterparts for 100 % of that cluster's genes. Overall this is a close match.
CJLEIP_03619 matches XNR_3446 (Nonribosomal peptide synthetase) of BGC0001792 at 99 % identity.
CJLEIP_03620 matches XNR_3447 (Nonribosomal peptide synthetase) of BGC0001792 at 100 % identity.

CJLEIP_03624 matches XNR_3449 (Nonribosomal peptide synthetase) of BGC0001792 at 99 % identity.
MIBiG lists the compound class of BGC0001792 as NRPS.
MIBiG records antifungal activity for surugamide A and surugamide D (BGC0001792).
MIBiG rates the annotation quality of BGC0001792 as questionable.
